subject.title: fix: block Cloud SDK workspace env controls [AI]

question: Should OpenClaw reserve the full project-local `CLOUDSDK_*` namespace as untrusted and make explicit `undefined` child-environment values remove inherited keys globally?
rationale: The patch closes a security-sensitive workspace-to-subprocess path, but it also intentionally ends project-local Cloud SDK configuration and formalizes a shared process-environment contract; repository policy requires owner acceptance for that compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed boundary
options.body: Merge after required checks, treating all workspace `CLOUDSDK_*` values as untrusted while retaining trusted shell and global dotenv configuration.
